assure success: Hard work alone cannot assure success; you also need good timing and a little luck.
光靠努力無法確保成功；你還需要好的時機和一點運氣。
assure someone of one's support: Before the big game, the coach assured the nervous player of his support and told him to relax.
大賽前，教練向那位緊張的球員保證會支持他，並叫他放輕鬆。
rest assured: Please rest assured that your personal information will be kept safe and never shared with others.
請放心，您的個人資料會被妥善保管，絕不會與他人分享。
attach importance to: Our school attaches importance to reading, so every classroom has a library corner and daily reading time.
我們學校重視閱讀，所以每間教室都有圖書角和每日閱讀時間。
attach a file: Don't forget to attach a file with your report when you email the teacher tonight.
今晚寄電子郵件給老師時，別忘了附加一個含有你報告的檔案。
be attached to one's hometown: Although he moved to Taipei years ago, Grandpa is still deeply attached to his hometown in Tainan.
雖然爺爺多年前就搬到台北，他仍然對台南的家鄉有深厚的感情。
attach conditions: My parents let me go on the camping trip, but they attached conditions: I had to call home every night.
我爸媽讓我去露營，但他們附帶了條件：我必須每天晚上打電話回家。
attach blame: It is not fair to attach blame to the driver before the police finish investigating the accident.
在警方調查完這起事故之前就歸咎於司機是不公平的。
attract attention: The street performer wore a bright costume to attract attention from people walking through the night market.
街頭藝人穿著鮮豔的服裝，以吸引走過夜市的人們的注意。
attract criticism: The official's rude comments online quickly attracted criticism from both students and parents.
那位官員在網路上無禮的言論很快就招致學生和家長的批評。
attract investment: The city lowered taxes to attract investment from foreign companies and create more jobs for young people.
這座城市降低稅金，以吸引外國公司的投資，並為年輕人創造更多工作。
attract tourists: The beautiful beaches and fresh seafood attract tourists to Penghu every summer.
美麗的海灘和新鮮的海鮮每年夏天都吸引觀光客到澎湖。
attribute success to hard work: The champion attributes her success to hard work and the support of her coach and family.
這位冠軍把她的成功歸功於努力，以及教練和家人的支持。
attribute the painting to Picasso: Experts once attributed the painting to Picasso, but new tests show that one of his students made it.
專家們曾認為此畫出自畢卡索，但新的檢測顯示是他的一位學生畫的。
be attributed to climate change: Scientists say the hotter summers in Taiwan can be attributed to climate change and the growth of cities.
科學家說，台灣越來越熱的夏天可歸因於氣候變遷和城市的擴張。
award a prize: The judges will award a prize to the student who writes the most creative short story.
評審將頒獎給寫出最有創意短篇故事的學生。
be awarded a scholarship: Because of her excellent grades, Mei was awarded a scholarship to study abroad in Canada.
因為成績優異，小美獲頒獎學金到加拿大留學。
award damages: The court awarded damages of one million dollars to the family of the injured worker.
法院判給受傷工人的家屬一百萬元的賠償金。
award a contract: The city will award a contract to the company that offers the lowest price for building the new bridge.
市政府將把興建新橋的合約發包給出價最低的公司。
back a candidate: Many young voters backed a candidate who promised cheaper housing and better public transportation.
許多年輕選民支持一位承諾提供更便宜住房和更好大眾運輸的候選人。
back down: Even when everyone disagreed with him, Tom refused to back down and kept defending his idea.
即使每個人都不同意他，湯姆也拒絕讓步，繼續為他的想法辯護。
back up the data: Always back up the data on your computer, in case it suddenly breaks and you lose all your files.
一定要備份電腦裡的資料，以防電腦突然壞掉而失去所有檔案。
back out of a deal: The buyer backed out of a deal to buy our house after finding problems with the roof.
買家發現屋頂有問題後，就退出了購買我們房子的交易。
balance work and family: Many working parents find it hard to balance work and family, especially when their kids are young.
許多上班的父母覺得很難平衡工作與家庭，尤其是在孩子還小的時候。
balance the budget: The government cut spending on several projects in order to balance the budget this year.
政府刪減了幾個計畫的支出，以便平衡今年的預算。
balance the needs of: A good city plan must balance the needs of drivers, bikers, and people walking on the street.
一個好的城市規劃必須兼顧駕駛人、騎單車的人和街上行人的需求。
hang in the balance: With the score tied and one minute left, the result of the final game is hanging in the balance.
比分平手且只剩一分鐘，決賽的結果仍懸而未決。
ban smoking: Many countries ban smoking in restaurants and other public places to protect people's health.
許多國家在餐廳和其他公共場所禁菸，以保護人們的健康。
ban someone from driving: After he was caught driving drunk, the judge decided to ban him from driving for two years.
他被抓到酒駕後，法官決定禁止他開車兩年。
a ban was lifted: After two years, a ban was lifted on travel to the island, and tourists finally began to return.
兩年後，前往該島旅遊的禁令解除了，觀光客終於開始回流。
impose a ban: The government decided to impose a ban on plastic straws to reduce waste in the ocean.
政府決定實施塑膠吸管禁令，以減少海洋中的垃圾。
